$comment: Design tokens — colour. Source of truth; src/generated/tokens.css is derived.
TIER 1 (primitive): raw values. Never referenced by a component.
TIER 2 (semantic): role names, themed. This is what components use.
TIER 3 (component): introduced with the first component that needs it (§5.8).
DISJOINTNESS RULE (§5.2.1): the `ui` and `data` namespaces share no values.
A chart series may never use a UI colour; a UI element may never use a data colour.

primitive.$comment: Ink scale is cool-cast near-black through near-white; see §5.2.2 on why not pure #000.
primitive.$comment-data: Okabe & Ito (2008) colourblind-safe qualitative palette. Peer-reviewed, grayscale-correct, recognisable to the audience. See §5.2.4 on why this rather than a bespoke palette.

dark.$comment: Contrast ratios against --color-canvas are asserted in scripts/check.ts. NOTE: this role must NOT be named `base` — Tailwind generates text-base as a font-size utility, and a colour token of the same name silently overrides it. See ENGINEERING_JOURNAL 2026-07-23 Sprint 3.

contrastFloors.$comment: Minimum contrast vs --color-base, enforced by `pnpm budget` (§12.2). AAA body text = 7:1.
